news.title: Mars has such thin air that around noon near the equator, sunlit ground beneath your boots could reach 24 degrees Celsius while the air around your head remained below freezing — allowing one standing person to span temperatures resembling spring and winter at the same time.
news.description:

news.title: Why Malibu is still a ghost town 18 months after Palisades Fire: ‘It looks like Pompeii’
news.description: More than a year and a half after the Palisades Fire tore through Malibu, only a handful of homes along the Pacific Coast Highway have begun rebuilding, leaving the once-iconic stretch a ghost town of charred ruins.
